description: Report returned by a build-loop builder or fixer: what it built, what it ran, where it deviated, what wall it hit, and what it still wants from the foundation.

routes.description: Routes built or touched this round.

files.description: Files created or edited this round.

checksRun.description: The exact commands run and their results, as text.

deviations.description: Where the build differs from the target path or contract, and why.

walls.description: A real wall hit and named plainly, or an empty string if none.

wantedFromFoundation.description: Things this job needed from the shared foundation that were missing or insufficient, for the orchestrator to act on between rounds.
